source: MCP tools/list result; shared by every supported revision

tools.description: submit (spec/key) can start Codex work via ordinary task admission. cancel (plan_id/key) stops new steps and asks running steps to interrupt. Inspect by plan_id, list by offset/limit. Uncertain outcomes await explicit resume.

spec.description: {"version":1,"name":"job","nodes":[{"id":"a","action":"start","target":{"project_id":"P"},"prompt":"Test"}]}. 1-16 nodes. Optional max_parallel 1-4 (default 2). after lists dependency ids. start targets project_id or absolute workdir. send/review target {"node":"a"} for start ancestor a. Only review may omit prompt.

tools.name: codex_plans

tools.description: Get Codex version, sign-in type, broker health, pending request summaries.
tools.name: codex_status

tools.description: list(offset/limit) shows registered projects. select registers an existing directory. create makes a plain one.
tools.name: codex_projects

tools.description: plan/create(repo, name, optional base). inspect(path, offset/limit). handoff(finished task_id) returns a patch artifact. cleanup(key) removes the managed folder. All but inspect need worktrees=true. Never merges/pushes.

keep_branch.description: Keep the branch cleanup would delete.

project_id.description: Instead of repo/path. Needed for cleanup.

tools.name: codex_worktrees

tools.description: Discover model ids, supported reasoning efforts and defaults. Catalog visibility is not an entitlement guarantee.
tools.name: codex_models

tools.description: Start a persistent conversation and promptly return its task id.

approval_mode.description: Native Codex reviewer; approve_for_me uses auto_review without disabling sandboxing

context_files.description: Read project-relative UTF-8 files into context.

project_id.description: Selected project; use instead of workdir

workdir.description: Absolute project directory chosen by the main agent

tools.name: codex_start

tools.description: Page persistent tasks, newest first. Large projections identify truncated_fields.
tools.name: codex_list

tools.description: Read task state, cumulative usage and workspace ownership. See truncated_fields.

result_id.description: Reuse to pin the result revision across pages.

turn_id.description: result reads this turn's evidence (default current turn).

view.description: default gives details, compact a summary. Page separately with requests_cursor, subagents_offset/subagents_limit and claims_offset/claims_limit. reconciliation reads the recovery report. permissions gives receipts and scope. offset/limit count artifact bytes or result/permissions records.

tools.name: codex_get

tools.description: Replay details from after and drain has_more. Keep after and event_seq for fragments. Pass next_event_offset as event_offset until fragment_complete.

view.description: outcome coalesces state for task_ids. Return opaque cursors unchanged.

tools.name: codex_events

tools.description: follow_up starts another turn. steer adds input to the active turn and needs its expected_turn_id. Only follow_up takes model, effort and output_schema.

context_files.description: Read project-relative UTF-8 files into context.

tools.name: codex_send

tools.description: Reconcile native history and execution intent after reconnect. No prompt or command replay. Inspect codex_history before a follow-up.
tools.name: codex_resume

tools.description: Ask Codex to interrupt the specified active turn. Poll for interrupted/completed; interrupt acknowledgement alone is not completion.
tools.name: codex_interrupt

tools.description: Page owned turns/items saved across outages. Large items flag truncated_fields. Pending approvals use codex_review_request.
tools.name: codex_history

tools.description: Page bounded pending approval/question summaries using cursor. Fetch complete content by id with codex_review_request before approval. Never infer approval from silence or timeout.
tools.name: codex_requests

tools.description: Answer pending guidance or review requests. Approvals need human/relay. Denials need no human.

proposal_hash.description: Accept file_approval with the hash shown at review. If redacted, human only.

request_id.description: Pending ID, not a retry key.

decision.description: Approval string or ask_parent object (version,id,context_hash,option_id,rationale). No form grants authority.

tools.name: codex_respond

tools.description: With offset (from 0), read details, no prompt. Follow next_offset until null. Check assembled text with detail_total_chars and detail_sha256. Omit offset for a client form that may relay the human's decision. Without forms it stays pending. Run server.py review REQUEST_ID in a terminal. Accept only complete content.
tools.name: codex_review_request

tools.description: Check native collaboration, permissions and direct input support.
tools.name: codex_capabilities

tools.description: get reads settings. Set current (running turn only, expected_turn_id) or next (future turns) with a key. Both take approval_mode plus model/effort/service_tier from codex_models. next adds access/collaboration_mode/budget. Pending approvals keep their reviewer.

budget.description: Root-only family lifetime caps apply now. Native continuations/children may exceed hard server turn/child admission caps. Active seconds/tokens/stored bytes may overshoot. {} clears.

tools.name: codex_settings

tools.description: Discover native descendants with refresh=true (cursor=nextCursor until null). Then page locally with refresh=false (offset=0, then next_offset until null). If can_accept_direct_input=false, use codex_delegate on that child's parent.
tools.name: codex_subagents

tools.description: Guide a parent (expected_turn_id if active). It may use native subagents. Find children via codex_subagents.
tools.name: codex_delegate

tools.description: Fork an idle owned conversation, optionally through a selected turn. Keeps project boundaries; does not start work or automatically continue a goal.
tools.name: codex_fork

tools.description: Rename an owned native conversation.
tools.name: codex_rename

tools.description: Archive or restore an idle conversation and its native descendants. Transcripts are retained.
tools.name: codex_archive

tools.description: Permanently delete an owned native conversation and descendants. Requires the exact native thread_id in confirm_thread_id and an idle family. Local bridge audit records remain.
tools.name: codex_delete

tools.description: Request native history compaction for an idle conversation; may consume model usage. Poll completion events.
tools.name: codex_compact

tools.description: Trim native history. Never reverts files. Local event audit stays.

before_turn_id.description: codex_history's logical_turn_id. Remove this and all later turns.

tools.name: codex_revert

tools.description: Manage native queued instructions. add may run immediately. add/update need prompt (optional images/context_files/skills). update/delete need queued_id, reorder needs ordered_ids. start uses conversation settings and optional queued_id. Changes need an operation key.

context_files.description: Read project-relative UTF-8 files into context.

tools.name: codex_queue

tools.description: Run native code review on an idle task. Poll for findings. custom uses instructions.
tools.name: codex_review

tools.description: List this task's native background processes (cursor/limit). terminate(process_id,key) stops one. clean(key) stops all. No shell or stdin.
tools.name: codex_terminals

tools.description: get reads a goal. clear removes it. set takes objective, status or native token_budget, separate from the codex_settings family budget. Active goals may continue work and consume usage. set/clear need explicit human instruction, user_requested=true and an operation key.
tools.name: codex_goal

tools.description: List native project skills. start/send take enabled names. No global config writes.
tools.name: codex_skills

tools.description: Retrieve the current native turn's diff and reported file changes; old diffs are not carried into new turns. Does not invoke Git hooks or execute a shell.
tools.name: codex_diff

tools.description: Read native account rate limits/remaining allowance. Does not buy credits or change billing.
tools.name: codex_usage

tools.description: For this project, list native sessions including Codex CLI (cursor/limit/archived) or import a root thread_id as a bridge task (key, optional archived). Native scope checked before work.

confirm_stopped.description: Import needs true (stopped in all other Codex clients).

project_id.description: Selected project; use instead of workdir

workdir.description: Absolute project directory chosen by the main agent

tools.name: codex_sessions
